errors.text_span: ценова стратегия на база стойността на продукта за клиента
errors.evidence: The description paraphrases the label for the third category. The actual label on the chart is "Ценова стратегия на база ценност на продукта за клиента". The generated description changes the word "ценност" (value/worth) to "стойността" (value/cost) and also omits "Ценова" (Pricing) in its second mention.
The data label for the first bar is explicitly "51,0%". The description rounds this to "51%", losing the stated precision of the original data.
